history.summary: A freehold 807 sqft 1BR at $1.15M in D14, 660m from Aljunied MRT, with a clean resale-only 4.23%/yr CAGR and a $1,425 PSF that is essentially at the URA median ($1,570). Freehold + low quantum + city-fringe location are solid, though 807 sqft is unusually large for a 1BR (size masking PSF) and the 24-txn sample is modest.
history.rating_rationale: A clean, no-red-flag profile: freehold, resale-only 4.23%/yr (no new-launch bias), $1.15M deep-pool quantum, and D14's Paya Lebar growth corridor with Aljunied EWL 660m away. Two reasons it stays Neutral rather than Buy: (1) an 807 sqft '1BR' is oversized for the type — the low $1,425 PSF partly reflects size, and per-dollar appreciation on a large 1BR is diluted; and (2) 24 URA txns is a modest sample. PSF sits ~9% under median $1,570, which helps. A steady, fairly-priced hold rather than a standout.

history.summary: Freehold 2015 project in Geylang/Eunos (D14) where the asking $1,425 psf is verifiably ~9-10% below real recent transactions (avg ~$1,577 psf over 12 months, with a Nov-2025 print at $1,648 psf). The value is corroborated by actual sales, not just the algo, which lifts confidence above the thin-cohort names. Main caveats are modest transaction volume (49 sales since 2015) and Geylang's location stigma capping liquidity.
history.rating_rationale: Verified recent transactions average S$1,577 psf (6mo S$1,571, range S$1,541-S$1,648 to Nov 2025); the S$1,425 asking is a genuine ~9-10% discount to live comps, consistent with the algo's -24.2% age_adj_premium and -9.2% cohort signal. D14 is an RCR/OCR-edge district with solid forward realized returns per v3.4 priors. appreciation_pct=4.23% on 24 ura txns is real-ish but per v3.4 carries ~0 forward weight - I lean on the verified cheap-vs-comps instead. psf_cohort_txns=0 means the same-size band is unverified by the algo, so I cap at medium confidence despite the favorable web evidence.
red_flags: psf_cohort_txns=0: no same-size comparable in the algo - cohort discount is from project pool, verify the 1BR band specifically
Only ~49 sale transactions since 2015 across 106 units = thin volume, slower exit
Geylang address carries a persistent location stigma that can cap buyer pool and resale liquidity
catalysts: Aljunied MRT (~7 min) and Paya Lebar interchange / commercial node nearby supports rental demand
Freehold tenure (durability, though not a forward price driver per v3.4)
Verified asking is below live recent transactions - room for mean-reversion upside
